original: Hello,how can I help you today?
I need to check the shipping status of an order I haven't gotten yet.
Alright, I can help you with that.
Can I get your full name or Account ID?
Thank you Crystal. While I pull up your account I will just clarify that you wanted to check on the shipping status of your order?
Account has been pulled up for Crystal Minh.
Can I also get your account ID and Order ID so I can verify your identity?
One moment while the system searches for this.
Querying the system for an answer ...
Did you think you should have received your item by now?
yes, I should have gotten it 5 days ago
So you have been waiting 5 days for it?
How long have you been waiting for this? Has it only been 5 days?
Yes. i have been waiting 5 days.
It can take up to 7 days to arrive so it will likely be there soon. If it doesn't arrive after 7 days we can look in to it again.
I was told it would arrive sooner, and I need it by Monday.
Do you know the shipping status?
No I contacted you to find that out.
Yes, I realize that. But normally the package takes 7 days and it has only been 5.
I really need them by monday for an event. Can you tell me the status.

Your order should tell you the shipping status. If it has not been sent yet I can change it to overnight shipping. But without the shipping status I do not know if it has been sent. My system does not give me that information.
It hasn't given me any notifications on shipping. Can you change it now?
I can not change it without knowing if it has left our facility.
Can you overnight a new order and I'll send the other back if it ever comes?
I need these jeans for a photoshoot event
I can do that. One moment please.
Membership level of silver has been noted.
Since your are a silver member I will ship your item overnight free of charge. What brand of jeans were you looking at?
One pair was Guess and the other was Calvin Klein
A purchase of Guess jeans was made.
A purchase of Calvin Klein jeans was made.
I have ordered those for you Crystal. They will arrive tomorrow morning. When the other package shows up you can call us and we will get you a label for your return.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
